title: Spring Boot Autowired Service NullPointerException
fullLog:
java.lang.NullPointerException: Cannot invoke "com.example.service.UserService.getUserById(Long)" because "this.userService" is null
	at com.example.controller.UserController.getUser(UserController.java:24)
	at java.base/jdk.internal.reflect.DirectMethodHandleAccessor.invoke(DirectMethodHandleAccessor.java:103)
	at java.base/java.lang.reflect.Method.invoke(Method.java:580)
	at org.springframework.web.method.support.InvocableHandlerMethod.doInvoke(InvocableHandlerMethod.java:255)
	at org.springframework.web.method.support.InvocableHandlerMethod.invokeForRequest(InvocableHandlerMethod.java:188)
rootCause: The UserController failed to inject the UserService dependency because UserController was instantiated manually instead of being managed by the Spring container, or the UserService class is missing a component scanning annotation like @Service.
fix: Ensure that the UserController is annotated with @RestController and UserService is annotated with @Service. Avoid manual instantiation (e.g., 'new UserController()') and use Spring's dependency injection mechanisms (@Autowired or constructor-based injection).

title: PostgreSQL Connection Pool Exhaustion
fullLog:
FATAL: remaining connection slots are reserved for non-replication superuser connections
	at pool.js:23:17
	at process.processTicksAndRejections (node:internal/process/task_queues:95:5)
	ConnectionError: database connection timeout after 5000ms
	at Pool.connect (node_modules/pg/lib/pool.js:45:11)
	at Object.query (src/lib/db.ts:18:22)
rootCause: The application is opening database connections but failing to release them back to the connection pool (connection leak), or the pool max size is configured too low for the concurrent load.

title: Next.js React Hydration Mismatch
fullLog:
Error: Hydration failed because the initial UI does not match what was rendered on the server.
Warning: Text content did not match. Server: "Login" Client: "Welcome, User!"
	at div
	at main
	at Page (src/app/page.tsx:12:10)
	at InnerLayout (src/app/layout.tsx:18:14)
rootCause: The application rendered dynamic content (such as reading from localStorage, using window width, or checking browser-only auth states) on the client side immediately during the initial render without waiting for the component to mount, causing the server-rendered HTML to differ from the client-rendered virtual DOM.

title: SQLAlchemy Timeout / Connection Closed
fullLog:
sqlalchemy.exc.OperationalError: (psycopg2.OperationalError) connection to server at "localhost" (127.0.0.1), port 5432 failed: Connection refused
	Is the server running on that host and accepting TCP/IP connections?
During handling of the above exception, another exception occurred:
	at sqlalchemy.engine.base.Engine.connect (engine/base.py:3268)
	at app.py:14:5
rootCause: The database server is not running, or is running on a different port, or firewall configurations/pg_hba.conf are rejecting TCP/IP connections from the application host.
fix:
1. Verify that the PostgreSQL database service is running locally (`Get-Service postgresql*` on Windows or `systemctl status postgresql` on Linux).
2. Verify the host, port, database name, and credentials inside the database connection string.
